title: Replicating SHADE-Arena Monitoring Evasion Analysis on Smaller Context Windows

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful chain: characterizing how context limitation affects monitoring evasion is relevant for constrained deployments. However, the result primarily describes a confound rather than advancing a defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SHADE-Arena has 5 public tasks. Context truncation is a straightforward experimental control. Running with Llama-3.1-8B is feasible on medium compute. Setup of SHADE-Arena is the main complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experimental variable (context window size) with 2-3 conditions. Clear metrics. The SHADE-Arena setup is a fixed cost; the experimental variation itself is lean. Feasible if setup is smooth.
